description: Live open/half/closed status for exchanges, evaluated against real trading hours and today's trading holidays in each exchange's timezone. Includes next_open_at and next_close_at timestamps. Pass a MIC (e.g. XNYS) for one market or omit it for all. Requires a plan with exchange trading data (Free, Exchange, or All-in-one).
name: market_status
title: Market open/closed status
